name: North Carolina Mini Qualifier 2026
information: This competition will **not** hold the 3x3x3 speedsolving event. There will be side events in the morning and afternoon, and in the middle of the day, the [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026) will be held at the same location. If you want to compete in FMC, you must sign up for that competition separately. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDM1NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d9cae9d8ff46f8d2ea459941cb151cadd0782269/SOUTHEAST_5%20(1).png) This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026#70504-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
